findings.why: The proposal is to add Alluminio Bormida (SUP-B) as a second source for BR-180. No controlled record in the documents covers SUP-B for BR-180. That means no record for any receiving plant or customer, and there is no part card for BR-180. The only approval on file for SUP-B is for BR-220. So absence of approval can't be read as 'not approved'. A person must confirm whether a current approval exists for SUP-B, BR-180, the receiving plant and the customer.
